reason: The README describes a portable Windows one-click launcher that bundles Node.js, configures a DeepSeek API key, starts the local DeepSeek Harness web service, and opens its browser interface; its primary purpose is general utility and setup automation.

summaries.zh: 一个适用于 Windows 的便携式一键启动器，用于配置并启动 DeepSeek Harness 本地 Web 界面。
summaries.en: A portable Windows one-click launcher that configures and starts the local DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Executes a bundled Windows launcher and Node.js runtime
Starts a local DeepSeek Harness web service
Writes a user-provided DeepSeek API key to local configuration
Opens the local web interface in a browser
Uses the DeepSeek API through the launched service
